audio.subtitle: Input and room acoustics
audio.activityHint: The mic opens above a set level
audio.pttKeyHint: Click the button, then press the key you want, for example Space or Ctrl.
audio.advice: Ask the other person in the room to talk normally and watch the bar. Set the slider so their voice stays below the white line in the yellow zone (about 30 % to 45 %). When you speak, the bar swings green past the line and only your voice is sent.
audio.agcHint: Recommended: off. When on, the mic boosts quiet sounds between words, so a voice in the background is sent loudly.
audio.echoHint: Prevents feedback and echo when sound from the speakers gets back into the mic.
audio.noiseHint_ai: DeepFilterNet3 removes typing, clicks, fans and background noise at full audio quality. It runs entirely in your browser; your audio never leaves your device for it. One-time download of about 10 MB.
audio.noiseHint_ai-lite: A small AI model (GTCRN) for slower computers. Filters about as well, but voices sound a little duller.
audio.noiseHint_browser: Your browser's noise suppression dampens steady sounds such as fans or hum. Uses less CPU.
audio.noiseHint_off: No filter. For studio microphones or when you share music.
audio.micTestHint: When testing your mic, you are muted for others in the channel and hear your own voice with your current noise gate and filter applied.
audio.qosTitle: Quality of Service high packet priority
audio.qosHint: Prioritizes voice and video network packets (DSCP) to reduce stutter under heavy network load.
audio.noAudioWarningTitle: Warn when no audio is detected
audio.noAudioWarningHint: Shows a notification when your microphone is unmuted but no voice signal is detected.
audio.noAudioDetectedToast: No audio detected: Your microphone is unmuted but no audio is coming through. Check your input settings or permissions.
audio.switchChannelWarningHint: Asks for confirmation before moving to a different voice channel.
audio.switchChannelPrompt: Are you sure you want to switch to the channel "{channel}"?
audio.soundsHint: Plays audio cues when joining, leaving, muting, and deafening.
audio.outputDeviceUnsupported: This browser can't pick an output device; the system default is used.
audio.perUserVolumeHint: Make single people louder or quieter with a right-click on their name or tile.

stats.title: Connection status
stats.subtitle: Measured by the browser (WebRTC getStats)
stats.privacyNote: Voice and screen are encrypted on the way to the server. The server (SFU) decrypts the packets to forward them to the other participants; there is no end-to-end encryption and nothing is recorded.

legal.title: Legal & privacy notice
legal.subtitle: Transparency, data protection (Art. 13 GDPR) and terms of use for Mnema Talk

operator.heading: 1. Operator & controller
operator.introAfter: is a private, non-commercial software project for closed communities – with no profit motive, no advertising revenue and no business relationship. Accounts are issued only through personal invite codes.

privacy.heading: 2. Privacy notice under Art. 13 GDPR
privacy.introBefore: Your privacy and data sovereignty come first. Only the technical minimum needed for reliable chat, voice and video is collected. Your data is
privacy.introStrong: never sold, never passed on to advertisers and never used to train AI models
privacy.basisConsent: : By registering and using your invite code you consent to your profile data and uploaded media being stored.
privacy.basisContractTitle: Performance of a contract / terms of use (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR)
privacy.basisContract: : To provide the chat and voice service, authentication and session management.
privacy.basisInterest: : Short-lived error and access logs to protect against abuse and brute-force attacks.
privacy.voiceHeading: WebRTC voice, video & screen sharing: 100% routed through the server
privacy.voiceBefore: Unlike typical chat apps, Mnema Talk runs a dedicated
privacy.voiceNoP2p: There are no direct peer-to-peer connections between participants.
privacy.voiceAfter1: Your IP address is therefore never disclosed to other people in a call. Audio streams and screen shares are forwarded selectively in real time in memory and
privacy.voiceNoRecord: are never recorded or stored permanently
privacy.stunBefore: To set up the voice connection, your browser asks the following STUN servers for your public address:
privacy.stunAfter: . Your IP address is sent to the operator of each of these servers; no conversation or message content is transmitted.
privacy.noStun: No external STUN or TURN servers from third parties are used.
privacy.mediaPurpose: Images, documents and avatars in the local S3 storage
privacy.sessionRetention: Up to {days} days or until you sign out
privacy.rightsHeading: Your rights as a data subject
privacy.rights1Before: Under Art. 15–22 GDPR you have the right at any time, free of charge, to
privacy.rights1Mid5: . To exercise these rights, simply email
privacy.rights2Before: You may also object to processing based on legitimate interests (Art. 21 GDPR) and withdraw any consent you gave at any time with effect for the future (Art. 7(3) GDPR). You also have the right to
privacy.rightsComplain: lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority
privacy.rights2After: (Art. 77 GDPR), in particular in the country where you live or where the operator is based.
privacy.noiseFilter: AI noise suppression (DeepFilterNet3 or GTCRN) runs entirely in your browser. Your microphone signal is not sent to any third party for it; the model and code come from this server.

cookies.heading: 3. Cookies & local storage
cookies.body: Mnema Talk does not use marketing, tracking or third-party cookies. In line with § 25(2) TDDDG, only strictly necessary session data (the sign-in cookie) and local settings (for example microphone level and noise gate thresholds) are stored in your browser. A cookie banner is therefore not legally required.

terms.heading: 4. Terms of use
terms.use: The platform is for private conversation. Users agree not to share unlawful, insulting, inciting or copyright-infringing content.
terms.liabilityBefore: Because this is a free, private spare-time project, it is provided “as is” (
terms.liabilityAfter: ) with no guarantee of permanent availability or freedom from errors.
terms.rules: The operator may suspend accounts without prior notice in cases of serious disrespect or threats to the security of the infrastructure.

oss.heading: 5. Open-source credits
oss.intro: Mnema Talk is free software itself (MIT license) and is built on free software. Here is everything we use and ship to you, with its license.
